steps.content: On the other end of the shackles, the filth has once again blocked your connection to Zoya. It makes your head throb with severe pain.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: F*** off! Don't touch her, she's mine! The Ring is mine! Let go of her!
You don't want to let it win. You don't want to hand Zoya over to someone else. If you let go now, you'll lose her forever.
But you're not the only person here.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Let go... No more... Let go now!!
A low voice rings in your head. Although it comes from the other end of the shackles, it doesn't convey that kind of madness and violence. Rather, it sounds like a tempting persuasion.
It's not time yet... There's still a chance...
Come forward... I'll... guide the way... for you...
The voice is fading away, together with the light of the shackles. You can no longer feel Zoya's presence, but you also don't feel you've lost her.
Before you, the contamination and monsters blocking you look distracted and confused.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: huh... phoo... What happened? That guy has woken up?

options: No clue, but I guess we'll be there soon

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: huh... phoo... Even if I wanna run, you're not gonna quit now, are you?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We're almost reaching the bald head. Let's climb to the top in one breath and end this once and for all!
